snippet.title: PAYDAY 2: Big Bank Heist DLC Trailer
snippet.description:
Read more about the Big Bank Heist here: http://overkillsoftware.com/thebigbank/

Visit us at E3 and be the first to take down the Benevolent Bank! Successful heisters get a chance to score some awesome loot, such as PAYDAY 2 swag, Logitech kits and Nvidia Titan graphics cards. Find us at the E3 west hall entrance consumer area - no ticket required!

PAYDAY 2 is an action-packed, four-player co-op shooter that once again lets gamers don the masks of the original PAYDAY crew - Dallas, Hoxton, Wolf and Chains - as they descend on Washington D.C. for an epic crime spree.

Buy PAYDAY 2 on Steam here: http://store.steampowered.com/app/218620/
